criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: Official Director pages document product/reference assets, but the anime benchmark does not test exact ASIN preservation or the first-10-seconds gate.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: Independent Physion leaderboard reports 77.8 overall and 84.5 Production Quality across its anime evaluation; raw AIVP artifacts are absent.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: Conversational multi-scene workflow, timeline refinement and up-to-five-minute output are documented; AIVP setup friction is unmeasured.

criteria.name: Control & consistency
criteria.notes: Physion reports strong identity/style/production metrics over a multi-prompt evaluation; exact repeatability under one frozen product brief is unknown.

criteria.name: Speed & reliability
criteria.notes: The benchmark establishes completed outputs but publishes no extracted render-time, timeout or failure-rate evidence.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: Physion reports US$21.30 per benchmark video. Current plan video estimates explicitly exclude Director, preventing a reliable AIVP cost model.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: Terms permit commercial use at Plus and above, subject to law and inputs; model-specific and transferred-client constraints require confirmation.

criteria.name: Automation & integration
criteria.notes: Official OAuth MCP and CLI support generation, references, result tracking and credit checks; integration has not been security-audited by AIVP.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Web service and USD self-serve plans are documented; terms place compliance risk on users outside the US and AU billing/access were not tested.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: Official affiliate programme offers 20% for 12 months after approval, but no CTA is allowed until acceptance and tracking verification.

analysis: The independent anime benchmark materially raises confidence in long-form narrative output, but its use case does not validate exact-product affiliate video. Cost evidence is currently incompatible with AIVP's <=US$2 usable-output target.
confidence_notes: Independent benchmark plus vendor documentation; no AIVP-controlled artifact-backed run, so confidence remains C.
